title: Young Adults With High Blood Pressure Face Higher Risk of Heart, Kidney Disease
desc: Recent research suggests that adults ages 30 to 40 with high blood pressure may face a higher risk of cardiovascular and kidney disease later in life. These findings highlight the importance of maintaining a healthy blood pressure at a younger age.
